latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of class-responsibility-realignment.

- Provides step-by-step process for redistributing methods and fields to their correct classes, repairing inheritance hierarchies, and extending unmodifiable library classes.
- Lists concrete triggers and code smells (Feature Envy, Shotgun Surgery, Middle Man, Inappropriate Intimacy, Data Clumps, hierarchy problems) that signal when to apply responsibility realignment.
- Outlines how to select and execute targeted refactorings such as Move Method, Extract Class, Pull Up/Down Method, Collapse Hierarchy, and Replace Inheritance with Delegation.
- Includes decision rules for balancing encapsulation versus delegation, and guidance for extending unmodifiable library classes.
- Designed for intermediate-level developers with object-oriented refactoring experience.
- Requires codebase access or a diagnosis report as input and prescribes incremental, compile-and-test validation after each change.
